topic: Simon Baron-Cohen, Alan Leslie & Uta Frith (1985) London Sally-Anne Marble Transfer False-Belief Experiment, Age-Four Parietal-Prefrontal Leap, Milton Double Empathy, and Adult Curse of Knowledge (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
